assumptions: Illustrative scenario only: all prices are invented inputs, not provider quotes or benchmark measurements.
A common workload volume and period are used; equal task quality is not established by this calculation.
Policy learning uses three hosted judge calls on every episode; fine-tuning uses the same judges on a 10 percent evaluation subset. Equal prices do not imply equal evaluation coverage or quality.
The same upstream serving costs are included once per approach through shared: 100 per period plus 0.002 per episode.
Four policy update/rollout cycles and one fine-tuning/rollout cycle are scheduled even at zero volume; their compute budgets stay fixed in the volume sweep.
Each approach retains 2 GB of existing data and averages 0.00002 GB of new retained data per episode over the period; GB-month means 30 days.
CPU is modeled at 0.02 seconds per episode at 0.36 per hour for each approach. Cycle compute is additional work, not those same CPU seconds.
Taxes, network transfer, retries, human review, and setup labor are omitted; add them to the appropriate fields before a purchasing decision.
